items.summary: Out-of-bounds write in the kernel's libceph code (bucket_perm_choose()), remotely triggerable with no privileges, affecting kernels up to 6.12.108/6.18.49/7.2.3.
Arbitrary file upload in the 10Web Booster WordPress plugin (≤2.34.10) lets unauthenticated attackers upload executable files and achieve remote code execution via a leaked REST nonce.
Stored XSS in Crafty Controller (≤4.10.8): unauthenticated attackers inject malicious content into server activity logs via spoofed X-Forwarded-For headers, executing in the admin's browser.

Improper origin validation in BeyondTrust Remote Support (≤26.2.3) lets remote attackers perform file operations unauthenticated; exploited as a zero-day since Aug 29, 2026 (Mandiant: ARMORY CASTLE) and added to CISA KEV.
OS command injection in ZoneMinder's downloadEvents() before v1.38.3: a monitor name with shell metacharacters breaks single-quote wrapping and executes commands via ffmpeg/tar/zip as the web user.
